title: Detailed pretzel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='dough' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f4b860'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#d98b2b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a95f18'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sheen' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd98a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0a94c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow under pretzel -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='33' ry='6' fill='#6b3a10' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- main dough loop: outer body -->
  <path d='M50 14
           C66 14 82 26 82 44
           C82 62 68 74 50 74
           C32 74 18 62 18 44
           C18 26 34 14 50 14 Z'
        fill='url(#dough)' stroke='#8a4c11' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- dough hole / inner opening -->
  <path d='M50 26
           C60 26 70 34 70 45
           C70 56 60 63 50 63
           C40 63 30 56 30 45
           C30 34 40 26 50 26 Z'
        fill='#7a4312' stroke='#5c3010' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- knotted crossing arms -->
  <path d='M30 40 C36 30 46 26 50 34 C54 42 44 52 36 54 C28 56 26 50 30 40 Z'
        fill='url(#sheen)' stroke='#b06a1c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M70 40 C64 30 54 26 50 34 C46 42 56 52 64 54 C72 56 74 50 70 40 Z'
        fill='url(#sheen)' stroke='#b06a1c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- lower twist loops -->
  <path d='M32 60 C40 68 46 72 50 84 C54 72 60 68 68 60 C60 62 54 64 50 70 C46 64 40 62 32 60 Z'
        fill='url(#sheen)' stroke='#b06a1c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- salt crystals -->
  <g fill='#fff6e0'>
    <rect x='38' y='20' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(-12 40 21)'/>
    <rect x='56' y='19' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(18 58 20)'/>
    <rect x='46' y='16' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(6 48 17)'/>
    <rect x='24' y='40' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(-28 26 41)'/>
    <rect x='72' y='38' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(24 74 39)'/>
    <rect x='66' y='50' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(10 68 51)'/>
    <rect x='28' y='52' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(-16 30 53)'/>
    <rect x='42' y='30' width='3' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(30 43 31)'/>
    <rect x='54' y='31' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(-22 56 32)'/>
    <rect x='36' y='64' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(14 38 65)'/>
    <rect x='60' y='63' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(-18 62 64)'/>
    <rect x='48' y='76' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(8 50 77)'/>
    <rect x='50' y='42' width='4' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(-10 52 43)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- warm highlight sheen spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffe1a0' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe1a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='6' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe1a0' opacity='0.55'/>
</svg>
